statement: Supermicro says it is now shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 racks, each with 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs across 18 compute trays, integrated with its direct liquid cooling stack.
why: An OEM moving next-generation racks into volume shipment is the point at which a new accelerator platform starts converting into revenue and deployed capacity.

impact.mechanism: Production shipment of an integrated Rubin rack with liquid cooling means the platform has cleared manufacturing and cooling readiness, so customer orders can be filled rather than merely booked.

evidence.excerpt: Supermicro Now Shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Racks
72 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs and 36 NVIDIA Vera CPUs
Our customers can now order a Scalable Unit and receive production-ready systems with end-to-end integration, because we design and build every layer between the cold plate and the cooling tower.

confidence.basis: Vendor press release treated as secondary; no shipment volumes, backlog or revenue figures are disclosed.
